normalization_obstruction: For orthonormal bases of each original sector, trace(T* T)=dim K. A spectrum with all singular values 1 except alpha<1 has trace dim K-1+alpha^2<dim K and cannot occur.
polar_residual_correction: On a singular direction, ||T-U|| gives |sigma-1|, not sqrt(1-sigma^2). The existing scalar Lean lemma does not prove the projector-angle bound.
threshold_discontinuity_example: Binary POVM E0=diag(1,1-delta,0,1/2),E1=I-E0,delta=1/5. Perturb E0 second diagonal down by epsilon. Both POVMs have nonzero full threshold sectors and injective orthogonal synthesis alpha=1; original canonical measurement movement=2delta, perturbed movement=0. There is no uniform Lipschitz movement without a threshold isolation hypothesis.
